title: ValuSpec: Plug-and-Play Candidate Valuation before Target Verification for Tree-Based Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.31338v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tree-based speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by verifying multiple candidate branches in parallel. However, in practical serving scenarios, similar requests repeatedly induce overlapping candidate branches. While retrieval-based methods mitigate this by reusing historical drafts, the resulting candidate trees often contain many low-quality branches as the candidate tree grows, which reduces verification efficiency and wastes target-side computation. To address this, we propose ValuSpec, a plug-and-play candidate valuation mechanism that filters low-quality branches from a supplied candidate tree before expensive target-side verification. ValuSpec introduces transfer-based supervision to align filtering with the target model's behavior. translated_title: ValuSpec：树形推测解码中目标模型验证前的即插即用候选评估机制
translated_abstract: 树形推测解码通过并行验证多个候选分支来加速大语言模型的推理。然而，在实际服务场景中，相似的请求会反复诱导产生重叠的候选分支。基于检索的方法虽然通过复用历史草稿来缓解这一问题，但随着候选树的增大，所得到的候选树往往包含大量低质量分支，这降低了验证效率并浪费了目标侧的计算资源。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了ValuSpec，一种即插即用的候选评估机制，可以在昂贵的目标侧验证之前，从给定的候选树中过滤掉低质量分支。ValuSpec引入基于迁移的监督，使过滤过程与目标模型的行为保持对齐。过滤阈值通过目标模型在校准集上的贪心轨迹估计得到，无需任何参数训练。随后目标模型对过滤后的候选进行验证（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: ValuSpec是一种即插即用的候选评估机制，通过免训练的阈值估计在目标模型验证前过滤候选树中的低质量分支，从而提升树形推测解码的验证效率并节省目标侧计算开销。
en_tdlr: ValuSpec is a plug-and-play candidate valuation mechanism that filters low-quality branches from candidate trees before expensive target-side verification using training-free threshold estimation, improving the efficiency of tree-based speculative decoding.
